_about: Per-card staging lines (F6.1). Inserted right after the Subject sentence by deck_builder.build_call. Sources: style_lab/2026-10-10_08_F6_roll/plan.json staging + production_spec_F6_1.json content_notes, owner F6 review 2026-10-10.

notes.108_minia: Main subject: a dense standing crowd of ordinary townspeople, many heads deep, filling the picture; faces at mixed angles, several turned to neighbours, a few facing forward with eyes just past the viewer. Insets: a queue boarding a bus; a crowded tram stop (both crowds, so the insets vote for the target word).
notes.366_eiti: Arrow in solid black ink. The corridor is clear of furniture.
notes.454_letas: Tortoise moving slowly as the main subject; the hare awake and running at full stretch in its inset, so the fast/slow contrast is unmistakable; any resting hare is curled up with eyes closed, clearly asleep.
notes.090_seima: Main picture: the family of four at an everyday meal at the kitchen table, bowls of soup, dark rye bread and tea; one parent facing the viewer with eyes just past the viewer's shoulder, the other parent turned toward the children, the children looking at each other or at their plates. Insets: the family gathering potatoes in the garden; the family walking together along a street.
notes.137_vestuves: Bride and groom looking at each other or at the ring; one guest facing the viewer, the others watching the couple.
notes.147_karas: Refugees looking along the road ahead; one child glancing back toward the viewer. No arrow points at any person; if an arrow is drawn it points at the soldiers and tank on the horizon.
notes.113_gydytojas: Keep the small red cross on the clinic building or medical kit; one doctor facing the viewer, the other attending to a patient.
notes.024_miestas: A Lithuanian town rather than a metropolis: five-storey panel blocks beside older brick and plastered buildings, a church tower in the distance, an Ikarus bus; people secondary to the street.
notes.041_klubas: The hall itself as the subject: a low stage with a small band, a bar or cloakroom, the lit entrance in an inset; dancers secondary.
notes.066_paltas: Standing man in a flat cap, near-frontal three-quarter view, face turned only a little, eyes resting just past the viewer's shoulder; the coat flat-laid beside him as the main subject.
notes.049_baznycia: A whitewashed village church with a separate wooden bell tower and a carved wooden roadside cross by the gate; a few villagers in their Sunday best walking toward it, the men bareheaded at the door.
notes.025_namas: A single-storey wooden farmhouse with carved window surrounds and shutters, a picket fence, and a well-sweep standing over its timber well-head with a bucket on the pole; one person in the yard. The house has crossed horse-head boards at the roof ridge and a small glazed porch.
notes.092_senele: An elderly grandmother in a cotton headscarf with set grey hair showing at the front, hands folded, a child beside her; she looks at the child, the child looks just past the viewer.
notes.110_mokytojas: A man and a woman teacher at a chalkboard, with three or four pupils at wooden school desks in the foreground, seen from behind and in profile; the woman lean with straight light-brown hair, the man side-parted; one teacher faces the class (the viewer), the other points at the board. The pupils are essential to the card.
notes.383_pirkti: A customer receiving wrapped goods across a plain shop counter with an abacus and a scale; the shop assistant in a white smock; both looking at the goods.
notes.182_duona: A dense dark Lithuanian rye loaf: near-black crust and dark brown crumb, brick-shaped, whole, with a cut slice beside it on a linen cloth; inset of hands slicing it; inset of dark rye loaves on a shop shelf. Behind, a clay jug on a plank shelf against a log wall. No white or wheat loaf anywhere on the card.
